name: swipe-actions
title: Swipe Actions
description: "Actions behind a row of a list, as the swipe actions of an iOS list: a swipe across the row reveals them, a full swipe runs the first one, and each is a button for the keys."
docs: Import as `import { SwipeActions } from '@/components/ui/swipe-actions'`. See https://plexui.com/vue/components/swipe-actions for props and examples.
